title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Solid Brass Hardware Bathroom Storage | Glokzin Teal | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized, space-saving storage to your bathroom with this wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and solid brass hardware in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Designed to coordinate within the Carolina Collection, it complements transitional bathroom hardware and works well with versatile bath accessories.
